build_forced_aligner: build a Wav2Vec2ForcedAligner to align speech waveforms with transcript text using a CTC model
transcribe_waveforms: transcribe a list of audio waveforms into emissions and decoded text transcripts
force_align_emission: force align a transcript string against CTC emission probabilities to produce word-level timestamps
process_utterance: process an audio waveform into a prosodically annotated Utterance with word start and end times
backtrack_trellis: backtrack through a CTC trellis to compute the most likely transcription path with frame-wise probabilities
